examples.description: Auto-tone a product photo, lift the muted colours and darken the corners. Replace the asset keys with asset_key values from your own earlier image results.

description: Apply 1..10 adjustments to a photo in order, with the editor's own kernels: a one-op stack returns the same pixels as that tool in the editor. ops is a list of {op, params}; each op takes only its own params keys, and a key left out takes that op's default: brightness_contrast (brightness, contrast), exposure (stops), temperature_tint (temperature, tint), vibrance_saturation (vibrance, saturation), curves (rgb, red, green, blue), levels (in_black, in_white, levels_gamma, out_black, out_white), hsl_per_range (range, hue, saturation, luminance), sharpen (amount, radius, shadow_protect, highlight_protect), blur (radius), denoise (luminance_strength, chrominance_strength, radius), vignette (amount, midpoint, feather), grain (amount), black_and_white (red_weight, green_weight, blue_weight, tint_color), auto_tone (aggressive). output_format is png (the default, free), jpeg or webp ($0.0005 for the one Images encode, charged only when the result is delivered). Free for png output, $0.0005 for jpeg or webp: runs on the platform's own deterministic kernel, so the same input and arguments always return the same pixels. Takes PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC. Returns JSON {images:[{url, asset_key, download_url?, width, height}], price, next} plus a preview; images are stored in this workspace. Refuses: SIMPLER_MEDIA_INPUT_MISSING (pass the url or the asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY (use this workspace's asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_URL_REFUSED (use https, data:image or an asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_PIN_TOO_LARGE (under 20MB), VALIDATION_ERROR with reason SIMPLER_EDIT_TOOL_ARGS_INVALID for an unknown op, a key the op does not take, a value outside the op's range, levels with in_white not above in_black, or an output_format outside png, jpeg and webp, SIMPLER_EDIT_SERVER_PIXELS_NEEDS_PNG (the file is not an image: send a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC), SIMPLER_EDIT_SERVER_PIXELS_TOO_LARGE (at most 4,194,304 pixels: run image.convert with width and height 2048 first), SIMPLER_IMAGES_BINDING_ABSENT (this deployment has no Images binding yet, owner step O-2: send a standard PNG), SIMPLER_IMAGES_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or SIMPLER_IMAGES_LEGACY_SUBSCRIPTION (an owner account step: send a standard PNG meanwhile), SIMPLER_IMAGES_INPUT_UNREADABLE (send a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC), SIMPLER_IMAGES_INPUT_TOO_LARGE (under 20,000,000 bytes and 100 megapixels), SIMPLER_IMAGES_TRANSFORM_FAILED (retry, or send a standard PNG); nothing is charged on any of them, and INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS or PAYMENT_REQUIRED only when the workspace is already overdrawn or past its spend cap (add credits or raise the cap). NEXT: pass images[0].asset_key as image_asset_key to the next image.* tool, or open download_url when the result carries one.

image_asset_key.description: Photo to adjust, as the asset_key of an earlier image result for this workspace (edit-projects/<tenant>/... or images/<tenant>/...). A key from another workspace is refused (SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY).

image_url.description: Photo to adjust: a public https URL, a data:image/...;base64 URL, or the url/url_path of an earlier image result (max 20MB; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; SVG is refused). Pass this or the matching *_asset_key, not both.

ops.description: Adjustments applied in order, 1..10. Each op takes only its own params keys: brightness_contrast (brightness, contrast), exposure (stops), temperature_tint (temperature, tint), vibrance_saturation (vibrance, saturation), curves (rgb, red, green, blue), levels (in_black, in_white, levels_gamma, out_black, out_white), hsl_per_range (range, hue, saturation, luminance), sharpen (amount, radius, shadow_protect, highlight_protect), blur (radius), denoise (luminance_strength, chrominance_strength, radius), vignette (amount, midpoint, feather), grain (amount), black_and_white (red_weight, green_weight, blue_weight, tint_color), auto_tone (aggressive).

params.description: This op's settings; omit a key for its default. A key another op takes is refused.

aggressive.description: auto_tone default false, scales the detected scene's preset 1.5x

amount.description: sharpen 0..4, default 1; vignette -1..1, default -0.3, negative darkens the edges, positive lightens them; grain 0..1, default 0.1

brightness.description: brightness_contrast -1..1, default 0, added to every channel

feather.description: vignette 0..1, default 0.5, 0 is a hard edge

in_white.description: levels 0..1, default 1, input white point, above in_black

midpoint.description: vignette 0..1, default 0.5, where the falloff centres, from the middle (0) to the corners (1)

radius.description: sharpen 1..20, default 2, pixels; blur 1..60, default 5, pixels; denoise 1..8, default 4, pixels

stops.description: exposure -5..5, default 0, a gain in linear light; +1 doubles the light and whites clip

tint_color.description: black_and_white #RRGGBB tint; omit for neutral grey

vibrance.description: vibrance_saturation -1..1, default 0, moves muted colours most and protects skin

output_format.description: Result encoding: png (the default, free), jpeg or webp ($0.0005, one Images encode at quality 85; a JPEG has no transparency, so transparent pixels come out white).

preview_format.description: Preview block after the JSON, at most 384px on the long edge and never charged: png, jpeg or none. Left out, a PNG result gets a png preview and a JPEG or WebP result a jpeg one. A result with no preview says why in preview_unavailable.

request_ref.description: Optional idempotency key (1-64 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same request_ref and the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result at $0 with replayed: true; the same request_ref with different arguments is refused (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_CONFLICT), and so is a retry whose first result was deleted since (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_RESULT_DELETED): send a new request_ref to run it again.

name: image.adjust
